none: PAS SWYOR-2F03A0: Roman Coin: Antoninianus of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy radiate of Carausius (AD 286-93), probably LAETITIA AVG (as opposed to LAETIT AVG), probably C Mint. The obverse legend is VIRTVS CARAVSI AVG (cf. RIC V, pt 2, cf. 254), or VIRTVS CARAVSI, the spacing suggesting that the latter is more likely. Neither legend is recorded in RIC with this actual reverse, so this is likely to be a new variety.
